qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unassailable liquidity network effect and multi-asset clearing cross-margining create massive capital efficiencies for market participants. Entrant threats (FMX/LCH) lack the multi-asset open interest depth required to offset CME margin efficiencies.

qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle financial excellence: FY25 revenue reached $6.52B (+6% YoY) with GAAP operating margin of 64.9% and net income of $4.07B. Operating/tangible ROIC has averaged 25.8% over 5 years (30.1% in FY25), with GAAP ROIC at 13.5%. Free cash flow conversion consistently hovers around ~100% (FY25 OCF $4.28B less capex $83.5M yields $4.10B FCF). Average daily volume set consecutive records (26.5M in FY24, 28.1M in FY25). Capital structure is pristine: $4.42B cash and equivalents against $3.42B long-term debt (net cash ~$1.0B), gross debt <0.85x net income, and interest coverage >30x. Capital allocation is exceptionally disciplined, returning substantially all FCF via quarterly base dividends and an annual variable 'fifth dividend'.
